findings.title: Developer machine timezone is Asia/Calcutta (IST, UTC+5:30)
findings.detail: process.env.TZ is null (not explicitly set). Node.js resolves the system timezone as Asia/Calcutta. Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone = 'Asia/Calcutta'. getTimezoneOffset() = -330 (minutes behind UTC, i.e. UTC+5:30).
findings.impactDetail: Determines which calendar date local Date methods return for edge timestamps

findings.title: SHADOWBOX container timezone is UTC
findings.detail: ENV TZ=UTC is declared explicitly in shadowbox/Dockerfile line 25. node:20-alpine defaults to UTC. UTC offset = 0 minutes.
findings.impactDetail: UTC is the decisive environmental difference that triggers the failure

findings.title: Critical timestamp crosses midnight between IST and UTC
findings.detail: The test uses timestamp '2024-01-14T23:30:00.000Z'. In IST (UTC+5:30) this is 2024-01-15 05:00 (Jan 15). In UTC this is 2024-01-14 23:30 (Jan 14). The calendar date derived from this timestamp differs by one day depending on the active timezone.
findings.impactDetail: One-day calendar date difference is the direct cause of assertion failure

findings.title: Developer machine Node version: v24.18.0 / SHADOWBOX Node version: 20.x
findings.detail: Local: Node v24.18.0, npm 12.0.2, Windows 10.0.26200. SHADOWBOX: node:20-alpine (Node 20.x LTS, npm bundled, Alpine Linux musl libc). Minor version difference but both support node:test and the Date APIs involved.
findings.impactDetail: Version difference is not the failure trigger; TZ is

findings.title: TZ environment variable is the sole differentiating factor
findings.detail: All other factors (Node runtime, test command, test files, source code, dependencies) are identical between local and SHADOWBOX. The only difference that produces the observed pass/fail split is the active timezone offset applied by the OS/runtime to local Date methods.

evidence.content: Copies exact same src/ and tests/; same npm test command; TZ=UTC is the single ENV difference

findings.impactDetail: Isolates TZ as the root environmental variable

findings.title: No TZ variable in demo-app package.json scripts (local test)
findings.detail: The 'test' script in package.json is 'node --test tests/invoiceChecker.test.js' with no TZ prefix. The 'test:utc' script uses 'cross-env TZ=UTC ...' explicitly to simulate the failure. The default test run inherits the system timezone.
findings.impactDetail: Confirms local test inherits IST from OS

findings.title: cross-env devDependency exists only to simulate the controlled environment locally
findings.detail: cross-env 7.0.3 is the only devDependency. It exists solely to allow 'npm run test:utc' on Windows (which cannot set env vars inline). It is not present in the SHADOWBOX container (npm ci --omit=dev).
findings.impactDetail: Tooling detail; not relevant to the failure mechanism

environmentDifferences.local: Asia/Calcutta (IST, UTC+5:30) - system default, TZ not set
environmentDifferences.effect: getDate() returns 15 locally, 14 in SHADOWBOX for timestamp 2024-01-14T23:30:00Z
No observed impact on test behavior
Both support node:test and identical Date APIs; not the failure trigger
